test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in a sentence.

He appealed to the laws of the land to __vindicate__ from his assailants.
solution:
The most appropriate meaning of "vindicate" in the given sentence is option **4) exonerate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vindicate"** (साबित करना) means to clear someone of blame, suspicion, or doubt and prove their innocence or correctness.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the person appealed to the laws of the land to prove their innocence or clear themselves from the accusations made by their assailants.
 
• **"exonerate"** ( "दोषमुक्त करना") means to absolve someone from blame or responsibility for a wrongdoing.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **exonerate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prove:** To establish the truth, validity, or genuineness of something by presenting evidence or arguments. (साबित करना)
 
• **Access:** The ability or right to enter, use, or retrieve something, typically a place, resource, or information. (पहुंच )
 
• **Banish:** To send someone away from a country or place as a punishment or to get rid of them; to exile or force someone to leave. (निकाल देना)

78:Td92,

The correct answer is 'Option 2'</s
